HEXER.title: The Hexer
HEXER.description:
Sora, the blind spirit-medium from the sunken shrine of the Underdocks.
Perceives Grudges through Psychokinesis, wielding Curses, Exorcism, and Blessing.
HEXER.cardsModifierDescription: Hexer cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
HEXER.eventDeathPrevention: ...The Grudges are not yet settled. I cannot fall here.
HEXER.aromaPrinciple: [sine][aqua]Listen... the grudges hum along the strings...[/aqua][/sine]
HEXER.goldMonologue: [sine]Perhaps these coins can rekindle the sunken shrine...[/sine]
HEXER.bestiaryQuote: Even behind blindfolds, this creature's malice rings clear.
HEXER.characterSelectDesc:
Blind of eye, yet attuned to lingering Grudges through Psychokinesis.
Begins with three special Curses and commands Exorcism, Blessing, and Abyssal Gaze.
HEXER.eventDeathPreventionLine: ...The Grudges are not yet settled. I cannot fall here.
